_note: Batch 17: ten REAL Perth bodywork & massage providers researched from public information on 11 Aug 2026, targeting the requested subtypes while avoiding the 18 bodywork listings already in the directory (checked by name and domain — zero overlap). Specialty coverage: Rolfing/structural integration, craniosacral, Thai massage, Bowen, reflexology + RLD, pregnancy, lymphatic drainage, relaxation, remedial and myofascial work. thai-massage, shiatsu, myotherapy, craniosacral and structural-integration were added to the specialty map in the same commit. Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no copied ratings, and no condition claims — several of these practitioners publish 'treats X' lists (Bowen sites especially); none of that is repeated. Honest gaps: no verifiable dedicated SHIATSU practice survived checking (the promising lead turned out to be a Melbourne clinic; parlour-directory pages don't qualify) and no dedicated MYOTHERAPY-titled clinic either — both subtypes are mapped and waiting for real candidates. Dropped during verification: Embody Health Subiaco (closed April 2026), Bodywest (site unreachable), Sukhothai (five locations but no verifiable addresses). Shambhala Therapy is search-level verified and flagged in its _source. New suburbs: Osborne Park (north), Mount Lawley and Bedford (central), Viveash (swan), Jandakot (freo).

categories.name: Bodywork & Massage
categories.blurb: Remedial, sports and relaxation massage, lymphatic drainage, Bowen and hands-on therapies.

listings.name: Structural Bodyworks
listings.address: 461 Scarborough Beach Road, Osborne Park WA 6017
listings.blurb: Perth's dedicated Rolfing practice: Kim works through the classical Rolfing Ten-Series of structural integration sessions, alongside Rolf Movement, fascial manipulation, craniosacral therapy and somatic education — slow, systematic work with the body's connective tissue rather than a standard massage menu. Weekdays by appointment, with one Saturday a month.
listings._source: structural-bodyworks.com — Scarborough Beach Road address, full service list, hours and email published; the phone number on their site is formatted as a US number, so it's omitted here rather than published wrong. Prices not listed

listings.name: Shambhala Therapy
listings.blurb: KMI structural integration in the Anatomy Trains lineage, practised from Mount Lawley rooms alongside myofascial release and craniosacral balancing — one of the few Perth practitioners working in this school of structural bodywork.
listings._source: Public directory listing — Railway Parade address, KMI/myofascial/craniosacral services; SEARCH-LEVEL verification only, no standalone website located. Drop before import if you'd rather not carry it

listings.name: Perth Thai Massage
listings.blurb: Traditional Thai bodywork on the Beaufort Street strip in Bedford, seven days a week: full-body Thai massage, foot reflexology and remedial work, with HICAPS on site for health-fund rebates on the remedial side. Walk-in friendly hours from 9:30am to 7pm.
listings._source: perththaimassage.com.au — Beaufort Street address, service list, seven-day hours, HICAPS, phone and email published

listings.name: Tara Massage Therapy
listings.blurb: A Stirling Street studio on the Northbridge edge of the city covering an unusually wide massage menu: traditional Thai and Thai aromatherapy, remedial, deep tissue, sports, pregnancy, reflexology and couples relaxation sessions, in sittings from one to two hours.
listings._source: taramassage.com.au — Stirling Street address, full service list, session lengths, phone published; prices not listed, email obfuscated on page

listings.name: MyoFix Massage Therapy
listings.blurb: An evidence-based remedial clinic near Carousel, running since 2017 under AMT-accredited founder Sowol Cheong — remedial massage with cupping and dry needling, foot reflexology, pregnancy massage, plus acupuncture and moxibustion from the East Asian side of the practice. Open seven days, 10am to 8pm.
listings._source: myofix.com.au — Kent Street address, founder's AMT accreditation and 20+ years, service list, seven-day hours, phone and email published; prices not listed

listings.name: Sharon's Reflexology & Bowen Therapy
listings.blurb: Sharon King has practised reflexology and Bowen therapy for eighteen years, splitting her week between George Street in Fremantle (Fridays and Saturdays) and Morley (Tuesdays and Wednesdays). Alongside foot and hand reflexology and Swedish massage she offers Reflexology Lymph Drainage — the RLD technique developed in UK cancer-care settings — as a gentle lymphatic option. Member of the Reflexology Association of Australia and the Bowen Therapy Federation.
listings._source: sharonsreflexology.com.au — both locations with days, 18 years' practice, RAOFA and BTFOA memberships, service list incl. RLD, phone and email published. RLD described by origin, not by outcome

listings.name: Perth Bowen Clinic
listings.blurb: Wendy Zajac practises Bowen therapy from Viveash in the Swan Valley — including Baby Bowen for infants and McLoughlin scar-release work — as a Bowen Association Australia member, nationally accredited and insured. Open six days with evening slots midweek and Saturday appointments to 3:30pm.
listings._source: perthbowenclinic.com.au — practitioner, Viveash location, BAA membership, service list, full weekly hours, phone and email published. Their condition list deliberately not repeated

listings.name: BODYSPACE Recovery Studio
listings.blurb: A family-run Jandakot studio pairing table work — remedial, relaxation, pregnancy, lymphatic drainage and chakra balancing massage — with a recovery wing of infrared wellness pods, body-roll and compression boots. Appointment only, massage from $115, booked through Fresha.
listings._source: bodyspacerecoverystudio.com.au — Biscayne Way address, service list, from-$115 pricing, appointment-only model, phone and Fresha booking published

listings.name: Keturah Life Day Spa
listings.blurb: A Perth day-spa institution running since 1994, with rooms in Nedlands and at Carine Glades in Duncraig. The massage menu spans relaxation, full-body, deep tissue, hot stone, pregnancy and remedial work, sitting alongside facials, infrared sauna and full spa packages — the classic long-afternoon escape as much as a treatment stop.
listings._source: keturah.com.au — both addresses and phones, since-1994 history, massage and spa menu published; per-treatment prices on their booking system

listings.name: Jade Clinic
listings.blurb: Chinese and Thai massage practised as therapeutic work rather than pampering — remedial-focused sessions drawing on both traditions, from city rooms. A small clinic run by dedicated therapeutic practitioners.
listings._source: jadeclinicperth.com — Chinese/Thai therapeutic positioning from their published pages; suburb and prices not confirmed, so the entry stays minimal. SEARCH-LEVEL verification, worth a manual check before publishing
